changes: Uses 121 KB of the shared module memory instead of 272 KB, so far larger module sets fit beside it.
Up to 24 of a project's 64 Parts hold MIDI scene locks; a lock in a 25th Part is refused with LOCKS: 24 PARTS.
A project with more locked Parts loads 24 and says LOCKS NOT LOADED; its file on the card stays untouched.
MIDI Scenes is back, rebuilt: hold SCENE A or B and turn a knob on a MIDI track to lock it; the crossfader morphs the locks and sends them as CCs.
Locks are saved with the project in their own file, so the LFO designer's shapes are no longer touched. Projects saved with 0.2 are converted the first time they load.
Works beside other modules. Needs Modwerk base 0.7.4 or newer, over USB.
Known issue: muting a scene (FUNC + SCENE A or B), saving, reloading and a power cycle are not yet tested with MIDI locks.
